name: B10-0117/2025 (Renew) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Nigeria to act. It calls for the release of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer held since 2020 and sentenced to death for blasphemy. It asks Nigeria to drop the charges against him, scrap its blasphemy laws, stop executions, and protect people from mob violence. It also raises the cases of Mubarak Bala and Rhoda Jatau.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Nigeria to free Yahaya Sharif-Aminu and drop all charges.
- Affects people charged with blasphemy in Nigeria, including Mubarak Bala and Rhoda Jatau.
- Next: Parliament sends its request to Nigeria's government and parliament, the African Union, the UN and European Union bodies.
